embed_text:
RW-POL-01 Rental Agreement & Terms, version 3.0 · effective 1 January 2025
Section: Introduction and scope

This agreement sets out the terms on which RideWise Mobility Pvt. Ltd. ("RideWise") rents bikes, scooters and electric vehicles to customers. By confirming a booking in the RideWise app, the customer accepts these terms, together with the Cancellation & Refund Policy, the Late Return & Damage Penalty Schedule and the EV User Guide.

text:
1. Eligibility

1.1 The customer must be at least 18 years old and hold a valid driving licence for the class of vehicle booked.

1.2 Each customer may hold one RideWise account, registered with a mobile number and email address.
embed_text:
RW-POL-01 Rental Agreement & Terms, version 3.0 · effective 1 January 2025
Section: 1. Eligibility

1. Eligibility

1.1 The customer must be at least 18 years old and hold a valid driving licence for the class of vehicle booked.

1.2 Each customer may hold one RideWise account, registered with a mobile number and email address.

text:
2. KYC verification

2.1 Every account goes through KYC (Know Your Customer) verification of the driving licence and identity. An account has one of three KYC statuses:

|KYC status|What the customer can do|
|---|---|
|VERIFIED|Book and pick up any vehicle.|
|PENDING|Book in advance, but the vehicle is released only after KYC is verified.|
|REJECTED|Cannot rent. Any existing booking is cancelled by RideWise.|

2.2 If KYC is still pending at the scheduled pickup time, or is rejected, RideWise cancels the booking. A booking cancelled by RideWise is always refunded in full (see the Cancellation & Refund Policy).

|PENDING|Book in advance, but the vehicle is released only after KYC is verified.|

2.2 If KYC is still pending at the scheduled pickup time, or is rejected, RideWise cancels the booking. A booking cancelled by RideWise is always refunded in full (see the Cancellation & Refund Policy).

text:
3. Hubs, pickup and return

3.1 Vehicles are picked up from and returned to the same RideWise hub. RideWise operates seven hubs, all in Bengaluru: Koramangala, Indiranagar, Jayanagar, HSR Layout, Electronic City, Whitefield and Hebbal.

3.2 The rental period runs from the scheduled pickup time to the scheduled return time shown in the booking. Rentals are booked in whole hours, with a minimum of 2 hours.

3.3 A return after the scheduled return time is a late return and is charged under the Late Return & Damage Penalty Schedule.

3.2 The rental period runs from the scheduled pickup time to the scheduled return time shown in the booking. Rentals are booked in whole hours, with a minimum of 2 hours.

citation: RW-POL-01 v3.0, 3. Hubs, pickup and return (p. 1)

text:
4. Rental charges

4.1 Each vehicle has an hourly rate and a daily rate (per 24 hours). The rental charge is always the cheaper combination for the booked duration:

• every full 24-hour block is charged at the daily rate; and • the remaining hours are charged at the hourly rate, but never more than one daily rate.

4.2 Worked examples (vehicle with an hourly rate of ₹80 and a daily rate of ₹700):

|Booked duration|Calculation|Rental charge|
|---|---|---|
|4 hours|4 × ₹80|₹320|
|10 hours|10 × ₹80 = ₹800, capped at one daily rate|₹700|
|24 hours|1 × ₹700|₹700|
|27 hours|1 × ₹700 + 3 × ₹80|₹940|

4.3 GST at 18% is added to rental charges, penalties and fees. When a refund is issued, the GST on the refunded amount is refunded in the same proportion.

4.4 The full rental charge is paid when the booking is made. Payment may be completed in more than one instalment before pickup. A failed payment attempt is not a payment and is never charged.

text:
5. Security deposit

5.1 A refundable security deposit may be collected when the booking is made:

|Vehicle type|When a deposit may be collected|Deposit|
|---|---|---|
|Bike / EV bike|Any rental|₹1,000|
|Scooter / EV scooter|Rentals of 24 hours or more|₹500|

5.2 The deposit is not a rental charge, carries no GST, and is returned to the original payment method within 3 working days of the vehicle's return. Unpaid penalties may be recovered from it.

5.3 Deposit returns are processed directly by the payment gateway and are not shown in RideWise booking or payment records.

text:
6. Customer tiers

6.1 Customers are placed in one of three tiers (STANDARD, SILVER or GOLD) based on their rental history. Tier benefits, including any grace period on late returns, are set out in Annexure A of the Late Return & Damage Penalty Schedule.

text:
7. No-shows

7.1 A booking is a no-show when the customer neither picks up the vehicle within 60 minutes of the scheduled pickup time nor cancels the booking before the scheduled pickup time.

7.2 The rental charge for a no-show is not refunded. No additional fee is charged for a no-show.

text:
8. Customer responsibilities

8.1 The customer must ride safely, follow traffic laws, wear a helmet and not lend the vehicle to anyone else.

8.2 The customer is responsible for traffic fines incurred during the rental period.

8.3 Damage found at return is assessed by hub staff and charged under the Late Return & Damage Penalty Schedule.

text: This schedule sets out the charges for late returns, low battery on EVs, and damage. All penalties attract GST at 18%.
embed_text:
RW-POL-04 Late Return & Damage Penalty Schedule, version 2.1 · effective 1 January 2025
Section: Introduction and scope

This schedule sets out the charges for late returns, low battery on EVs, and damage. All penalties attract GST at 18%.

text:
1. Late return fee

1.1 Lateness is measured from the scheduled return time to the actual return time.

1.2 Each late hour, or part of an hour, is charged at 1.5 times the vehicle's hourly rate. For example, 20 minutes late counts as 1 hour; 1 hour 10 minutes late counts as 2 hours.

1.3 Customers in some tiers receive a grace period before a late fee applies. Grace periods are listed in Annexure A. If a return is later than the grace period, the grace period does not reduce the lateness: the full lateness is charged as in clause 1.2.

1.4 Late fee examples (vehicle hourly rate ₹100, customer with no grace period):

|Returned late by|Hours charged|Late fee|
|---|---|---|
|5 minutes|1|₹150|
|59 minutes|1|₹150|
|1 hour 1 minute|2|₹300|
|3 hours|3|₹450|
|3 hours 15 minutes|4|₹600|

2.1 Check the battery level on the dashboard at pickup. Every EV leaves the hub with at least 80% charge.

text:
3. Charging

3.1 You may charge at any RideWise hub or an approved public charger. Charging at a RideWise hub is free.

Figure 1: How to charge a RideWise EV.
1. Park at a RideWise hub or approved charger.
2. Switch off the vehicle.
3. Connect the RideWise charging cable.
4. Wait for the green light on the dashboard.
5. Unplug and stow the cable under the seat.

Figure 1: How to charge a RideWise EV.

text:
4. Returning the vehicle

4.1 Return the EV to the same hub you picked it up from, with the battery level shown below in mind.

Figure 2: Battery level at return and the charging fee (battery gauge from 0% to 100%).
- RED (below 10%): ₹150 low-battery charging fee applies.
- AMBER (10% - 19%): no fee, but please charge before your next trip.
- GREEN (20% and above): ideal return level.
Exactly 10% is not below 10%, so no fee is charged.

section: 5. Frequently asked questions: Q. What happens if the battery runs out during my trip?
text:
Q. What happens if the battery runs out during my trip?

Stop in a safe place and call RideWise Support on +91 80 4000 1234. A team from the nearest hub will bring a charged vehicle or tow the EV. Towing is free if the vehicle had a fault; otherwise a recovery charge may apply.
